dashboard.name: BeforeShow · 同行与稳定性监控
dashboard.description: 真机 App Store / TestFlight，排除模拟器和侧载。邀请、分享、加入、失败原因、耗时、跨设备转化与埋点版本覆盖。

insights.name: 同行 · 技术成功率（7 天）
insights.description: 取消分享独立计数；技术成功率分母为成功+失败。创建、重发、分享、加入分别统计。

source.query: SELECT event, properties.source AS source, countIf(properties.outcome = 'succeeded') AS succeeded, countIf(properties.outcome = 'failed') AS failed, countIf(properties.outcome = 'canceled') AS canceled, round(100.0 * succeeded / nullIf(succeeded + failed, 0), 1) AS success_percent FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event IN ('companion_invitation_finished', 'companion_share_finished', 'companion_join_finished') GROUP BY event, source ORDER BY event, source

insights.name: 同行 · 失败阶段与原因（7 天）
insights.description: 包括邀请、系统分享、加入和 CloudKit 请求失败。错误代码无原始错误文本。

source.query: SELECT event, properties.source AS source, properties.stage AS stage, properties.error_category AS error_category, properties.cloudkit_error_code AS cloudkit_error_code, count() AS failures FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND ((startsWith(event, 'companion_') AND properties.outcome = 'failed') OR event = 'companion_cloud_request_failed') GROUP BY event, source, stage, error_category, cloudkit_error_code ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 50

insights.name: 同行 · 最近失败明细
insights.description: 真机正式分发；按版本、构建号、阶段和 attempt_id 定位。无姓名、链接或 token。

source.query: SELECT timestamp, event, properties.$app_version AS version, properties.$app_build AS build, properties.$is_testflight AS testflight, properties.$device_model AS device, properties.source AS source, properties.stage AS stage, properties.error_category AS error_category, properties.cloudkit_error_code AS cloudkit_error_code, properties.attempt_id AS attempt_id, properties.duration_ms AS duration_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND ((startsWith(event, 'companion_') AND properties.outcome = 'failed') OR event = 'companion_cloud_request_failed') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

insights.name: 同行 · 成功耗时 p50 / p95
insights.description: 毫秒；仅成功结束事件，按操作及入口分组。

source.query: SELECT event, properties.source AS source, count() AS samples, round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 0) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 0) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND startsWith(event, 'companion_') AND properties.outcome = 'succeeded' AND properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event, source ORDER BY event, source

insights.name: 同行 · 7 天邀请转化（成熟队列）
insights.description: 按匿名 session_id 跨设备关联。只统计已满 7 天的成功创建邀请；分享完成不等于朋友加入。

source.query: WITH invited AS (SELECT properties.session_id AS session_id, min(timestamp) AS invited_at FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = 'companion_invitation_finished' AND properties.source = 'create' AND properties.outcome = 'succeeded' AND properties.session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id), shared AS (SELECT properties.session_id AS session_id, min(timestamp) AS shared_at FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = 'companion_share_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'succeeded' GROUP BY session_id), joined AS (SELECT properties.session_id AS session_id, min(timestamp) AS joined_at FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = 'companion_join_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'succeeded' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT count() AS matured_invitations, countIf(shared.shared_at >= invited.invited_at AND shared.shared_at <= invited.invited_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS shared_within_7d, countIf(joined.joined_at >= invited.invited_at AND joined.joined_at <= invited.invited_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS joined_within_7d, round(100.0 * joined_within_7d / nullIf(matured_invitations, 0), 1) AS joined_percent FROM invited LEFT JOIN shared ON invited.session_id = shared.session_id LEFT JOIN joined ON invited.session_id = joined.session_id WHERE invited.invited_at <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

insights.name: 同行 · 超过 15 分钟未结束的操作
insights.description: 不是自动失败：退出、崩溃或停止分析可能缺少结束事件。按 attempt_id 查漏。

source.query: SELECT min(timestamp) AS started_at, properties.attempt_id AS attempt_id, any(properties.source) AS source, any(properties.$app_build) AS build FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND startsWith(event, 'companion_') AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY attempt_id HAVING countIf(endsWith(event, '_started')) > 0 AND countIf(endsWith(event, '_finished')) = 0 AND max(timestamp) < now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

insights.name: 同行 · 各构建的监控覆盖
insights.description: 用于确认 TestFlight 新版已经接入。旧版没有业务埋点，不能从 0 次事件推断邀请没被使用。

source.query: SELECT properties.$app_version AS version, properties.$app_build AS build, properties.$is_testflight AS testflight, countIf(event = 'Application Opened') AS opens, countIf(startsWith(event, 'companion_')) AS companion_events, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false GROUP BY version, build, testflight ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20

insights.name: 同行 · 最近 1 小时邀请准备失败
insights.description: 任一次真机正式分发失败即触发；每小时检查，订阅当前项目用户。

source.query: SELECT count() AS failures FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = 'companion_invitation_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'failed'

alert.name: 同行 · 邀请准备失败

insights.name: 同行 · 最近 1 小时加入失败
insights.description: 任一次真机正式分发失败即触发；每小时检查，订阅当前项目用户。

source.query: SELECT count() AS failures FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = 'companion_join_finished' AND properties.outcome = 'failed'

insights.name: 稳定性 · 最近 1 小时崩溃
insights.description: 真机正式分发的 $exception；每小时检查，只订阅当前项目用户。

source.query: SELECT count() AS crashes FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND properties.$app_namespace = 'com.doublewaterapps.beforeshow' AND properties.$is_emulator = false AND properties.$is_sideloaded = false AND event = '$exception'

alerts.name: 同行 · 邀请准备失败
